name: scaffold
description: Front 124 — the manifest `onze create --example bpp` writes: the scaffold's own (`onze/examples/scaffold/botopink.json`) with its pages as `.bpp` files, a content collection, and one new key. `bpp` names the package onto whose `pub default fn` the project's `.bpp` files unfold (front 116; decisions 198, 200): with it, `app/page.bpp` is a page; without it, the build stops at the first `.bpp` file and names this key.
